chunks: Among what was narrated by Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh al-Ḥalabī, who said:

I asked him about a man who forgot during two rakʿahs of a nafilah prayer and did not sit between them until he stood and bowed in the third. He said: “He should leave one rakʿah, sit, recite the tashahhud, and say the taslim; then afterward he should begin the prayer anew.”

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: the two units of prayer intended in the nafilah
key_terms.سَهَا: forgot or erred unintentionally during the prayer
key_terms.يَسْتَأْنِفُ: starts the prayer over again from the beginning

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they accidentally stand for a third rakʿah in a two-rakʿah nafilah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in a nafilah prayer when a person mistakenly proceeds into a third rakʿah without sitting after two. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to end the mistaken cycle properly with tashahhud and taslim, then restart the prayer afterward.
